summary: Keep GitHub observer refusals on real cooldowns and distinguish local observer budgets

replay.detail: Repeated provider refusals persist their latest next-check deadline instead of retaining the first reset. Existing observer claims remain readable; no replay or backfill is required.

rules.detail: Only future GitHub Retry-After/reset deadlines are accepted; absent a future deadline, primary and secondary limits wait fifteen minutes. The per-daemon observer cap is unchanged and is classified as a local refusal, not GitHub HTTP 429. Each same-origin REST redirect hop is separately admitted; cross-origin redirects are refused, and implicit transport retries are disabled in observer and authorized gateway clients.

compatibility.detail: Observer state can report error_code local-observer-budget and a local next-slot reason. Provider rate-limited remains unchanged. Older binaries read an unknown code as unreachable; rollout directly from any preceding binary requires no intermediate version.

manual.detail: No operator steps; the cap remains per daemon, not fleet-wide.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback is supported; persisted deadlines remain readable.
